rows.name: Vein (Ramjet Studios)
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 5, slightly modified according to Ramjet's FAQ. Community tools map it to UE 5.4 (CUE4Parse) and UE 5.6 (UE4SS game config).
rows.official_mod_support: None yet. Ramjet says official modding is planned. Community .pak and UE4SS mods exist, and UE4SS ships a Vein game config. The claim that the game warns about mods since 0.024 was not re-checked.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 2131400 ('VEIN Dedicated Server'), anonymous login, no game ownership needed. A native Linux build is confirmed (Vein/Binaries/Linux/VeinServer-Linux-Test). A Windows build is listed in Ramjet's docs but was not re-checked.
rows.anti_cheat: vendor unknown. The server's Game.ini has a bAntiCheatProtected toggle (False in the Pelican template) and a Steam bVACEnabled setting.
rows.status: early access on Steam, 24 Oct 2025 according to PCGamesN (date not re-checked)
rows.rea_notes: inspect_desktop_application can only flag UE5 (Content/Paks plus IoStore .utoc/.ucas). It cannot parse paks. The only way to the code is Ghidra on the shipping exe or the free Linux server ELF, which gives thin pseudocode with no names. The server ELF is the cleaner local target because no client anti-cheat is involved.
rows.legal_route: Playtest the game and run the free dedicated server to study its config (Game.ini) and server behaviour, then rebuild the systems clean-room. Do not extract or redistribute pak assets, and do not touch official servers or the anti-cheat setting.
rows.signature_system: Almost every world object can be interacted with, and zombies react to sound, light and movement in a persistent open-world New York.

rows.name: Project Zomboid
rows.engine: Custom Java engine on LWJGL/OpenGL. Much of the gameplay logic is in Lua, run by Kahlua, a Lua interpreter written in Java.
rows.open_source: no (proprietary; the Lua scripts ship as readable text)
rows.official_mod_support: Lua modding API (Javadocs at projectzomboid.com/modding) plus Steam Workshop. The Java core is generally treated as non-moddable.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 380870, anonymous login (confirmed via LinuxGSM)
rows.status: early access. Build 42 is the stable public branch as of 1 Sep 2026 (42.20.4-release), and the unstable beta has been removed. The earlier claim of a July 2026 switch was not confirmed.
rows.rea_notes: REA has no desktop JVM decompiler, so the Java .class core (zomboid.jar) is out of scope. The Lua layer can be read without REA. sqlite-jdbc-3.27.2.1 and the LWJGL jars are on the game's classpath, so SQLite save databases are plausible targets for inspect_sqlite_database. Bundled native libraries (for example FMOD) can only be examined in Ghidra.
rows.legal_route: Read the shipped Lua and the official modding API docs, run the free dedicated server, and use the Workshop. Do not decompile or copy the Java code, and do not redistribute assets.
rows.signature_system: Per-body-part injuries and infection: scratches, lacerations and bites carry different zombification odds and are treated in a health panel. This sits on top of moodle-driven needs in a persistent, fully lootable Knox County.

rows.name: Kenshi
rows.engine: Custom C++ engine on OGRE
rows.official_mod_support: Forgotten Construction Set (FCS), the official data and mod editor, plus Steam Workshop. The community RE_Kenshi/KenshiLib project (GPLv3, reverse-engineered, linked against OgreMain) adds native plugins.
rows.free_dedicated_server: no (single-player only)
rows.status: released 6 Dec 2018; Kenshi 2 is in development on UE5
rows.rea_notes: Ghidra pseudocode, strings and xrefs on the native x64 exe, with no managed metadata to help. FCS and the community OpenConstructionSet C# SDK (MIT) already read and write the game's data files, so most data structures can be learned without reverse engineering.
rows.legal_route: Use FCS to inspect items, factions, AI packages and dialogue, and playtest. Treat KenshiLib's reversed structures as reference only (GPLv3), and do not copy code or assets.
rows.signature_system: Per-limb health with crippling, severing and prosthetic replacement, in a world simulated by factions where the player's squad (from one character up to an army) has no special status.

rows.name: SCUM
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 4 according to Wikipedia at launch. Whether it has since moved to UE5 was not checked.
rows.official_mod_support: none according to Host Havoc's 1.0 coverage (no official tools or Workshop; only unofficial pak mods). Not re-checked.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 3792580, anonymous login. The binary is Windows-only (SCUM/Binaries/Win64/SCUMServer.exe), so Linux hosts run it under Wine.
rows.anti_cheat: The client has anti-cheat, but the vendor is unconfirmed: the early-access FAQ listed Easy Anti-Cheat, and a 1.0 hosting blog says BattlEye.
rows.status: 1.0 released 17 Jun 2025 (early access from 2018). Pterodactyl added the new server app on 20 Jun 2025, which fits that date.
rows.rea_notes: REA only detects the Unreal paks. The only way to the code is Ghidra on the huge exe. Because the client is protected by anti-cheat, the free Windows dedicated server binary and its config files are the only reasonable local targets.
rows.legal_route: Study the free dedicated server's settings and economy configs, and playtest on a private server. Never attach to or patch the anti-cheat-protected client, never touch official servers, and do not reuse extracted assets.
rows.signature_system: Full-body metabolism simulation that tracks calories, macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, digestion and muscle/fat mass, which feed into stamina, strength, stealth and health.

rows.name: Conan Exiles
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 4 for Legacy (CUE4Parse maps it to a modified UE 4.15). Conan Exiles Enhanced moved to Unreal Engine 5 in May 2026, and CUE4Parse and UE4SS both map it to UE 5.8.
rows.official_mod_support: Official Dev Kit (the UE editor through the Epic launcher, now called the 'Conan Exiles Enhanced Dev Kit') exposing nearly all maps, blueprints, meshes and animations. Mods ship through Steam Workshop, and the Enhanced server takes a mod list.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 443030, anonymous login. Enhanced ships a native Linux server (ConanSandbox/Binaries/Linux/ConanSandboxServer-Linux-Shipping) as well as Windows. The UE4 Legacy build stays on the 'conan-exiles-legacy' beta branch, which is Windows-only (Wine/Proton on Linux).
rows.status: released 2018; free UE5 'Enhanced' upgrade on 5 May 2026
rows.rea_notes: REA only detects the UE build. The official Dev Kit already shows blueprints and data tables in the editor, which is far better than Ghidra on the BattlEye-protected client exe. If code-level detail is needed, the native Linux server ELF is a local Ghidra target with no anti-cheat involved.
rows.legal_route: Study the systems in the official Dev Kit under its EULA and on a free dedicated server, then rebuild them clean-room. Do not lift Dev Kit assets or blueprints, and do not touch BattlEye or official servers.
rows.signature_system: Thrall capture and conversion: knock out and bind NPCs, drag them home, and break them on the Wheel of Pain (wheel tier and food set the speed) into fighter, archer, crafter or entertainer thralls.

rows.name: Outward: Definitive Edition
rows.engine: Unity (2020.3.26 according to the original sources; version not re-checked). The default Steam build is IL2CPP, and an official Mono 'modding branch' is offered as a Steam beta (named 'default-mono' in the original sources). The claim that the Epic build is Mono was not verified.
rows.official_mod_support: None official. The community uses BepInEx and SideLoader through Thunderstore, r2modman and Nexus on the Mono branch.
rows.free_dedicated_server: no dedicated server found (co-op is player-hosted; none in the LinuxGSM, Pelican or Pterodactyl lists)
rows.status: released 17 May 2022 (original Outward 2019)
rows.rea_notes: On the official Mono branch, Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll can be fed to inspect_managed_artifact and inspect_managed_members, and ILSpy gives near-source C#. On the default IL2CPP build, REA only gets type and method names from global-metadata.dat, plus Ghidra on GameAssembly.dll.
rows.legal_route: Switch to the official public Mono branch and read the decompiled code locally to understand the systems (as modders do with dnSpy), then reimplement them clean-room. Do not copy decompiled code or assets.
rows.signature_system: Defeat scenarios replace death with contextual outcomes (rescue, robbery, enslavement), and magic requires unlocking mana by permanently giving up max health and stamina, all within survival built around the backpack.

rows.name: Medieval Dynasty
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 4
rows.official_mod_support: None. The developers say modding might come only after active development ends. A community UE mod loader exists on Nexus.
rows.free_dedicated_server: no (co-op is player-hosted with a join code; no SteamCMD server in the LinuxGSM, Pelican or Pterodactyl lists as of Oct 2026)
rows.status: released 23 Sep 2021 on PC (consoles Oct 2022). The claim of a roadmap running to 2027 was not re-checked.
rows.rea_notes: REA only detects the UE4 paks and cannot parse them. The code can only be reached through Ghidra on the shipping exe, which gives low-level pseudocode with few names.
rows.legal_route: Playtest the game and observe its systems, then design clean-room. Do not extract or redistribute pak assets.
rows.signature_system: Dynasty succession (marry, raise an heir, continue as them) plus villagers assigned to automated jobs across a four-season calendar where winter stockpiles decide survival.

rows.name: Bellwright
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 5 (the official ModKit is UE 5.5.4 according to the modding docs; version not re-checked)
rows.official_mod_support: Official ModKit (a customised UE5 editor on the Epic Games Store) with Steam Workshop distribution.
rows.free_dedicated_server: no public dedicated server found (none in the LinuxGSM, Pelican or Pterodactyl lists as of Oct 2026; co-op is player-hosted). The reported announcement of self-hosted dedicated servers was not verified.
rows.status: early access since 23 Apr 2024. A PS5/Xbox Series launch on 9 Jun 2026 is reported by Gematsu (not re-checked).
rows.rea_notes: REA only detects the UE5 paks/IoStore. The official ModKit exposes items, structures, tech and blueprints far better than Ghidra on the shipping exe.
rows.legal_route: Study the data and blueprints in the official ModKit under its terms, plus playtesting, then rebuild clean-room. Do not copy ModKit content into a separate project.
rows.signature_system: Recruited villagers staff settlement jobs (gathering, research, guarding), then march as squads in formations that you command in battle.

rows.name: Soulmask
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 4. LinuxGSM classes the server as unreal4, and the official Modkit is on UE 4.27 according to the fandom wiki.
rows.official_mod_support: Official Soulmask Modkit (UE 4.27, Epic Games Store) for editing assets and building props, creatures and maps as .pak mods. The dedicated server accepts a comma-separated mod ID list.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 3017300 (native Linux, WS/Binaries/Linux/WSServer-Linux-Shipping), anonymous login. Windows app 3017310 comes from hosting guides and was not re-checked.
rows.anti_cheat: vendor unknown. A report of mandatory anti-cheat ('GameSecurityService') on official servers since update ten was not re-checked.
rows.status: early access from 31 May 2024 (LinuxGSM added the server on 16 Jun 2024). The original sources give a 1.0 release on 10 Apr 2026, which was not re-checked.
rows.rea_notes: REA only detects the UE4 paks. The official Modkit and the free native Linux dedicated server are the realistic local targets. Ghidra on the client is off-limits in practice if it is protected by anti-cheat.
rows.legal_route: Use the official Modkit plus a self-hosted dedicated server to study the tribesman and mask systems, then rebuild clean-room. Do not interfere with any anti-cheat or official servers, and do not redistribute assets.
rows.signature_system: Tribesmen management: recruit NPCs with their own stats and talents who gather and work on their own and can be trained, plus mask powers that progress and unlock abilities.

rows.name: Enshrouded
rows.engine: Holistic Engine (Keen Games' own in-house voxel engine, not Unity or Unreal). The engine name was not re-checked in this run. The native, Windows-only client and server executables are confirmed.
rows.status: Released 1.0 on 15 Oct 2026: Docker server images were patched that day for the '1.0 server'. Early Access ran from 24 Jan 2024. The platform claims (PS5 at 1.0, Xbox in early 2027) were not re-checked.
rows.official_mod_support: None found: no Workshop and no SDK. Community Lua and data-archive mods on Nexus are unofficial and tied to specific builds. Keen's FAQ statement about needing an SDK was not re-checked.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 2278520 with anonymous login (Pterodactyl egg and two Docker images, Oct 2026). The server is a Windows-only exe that runs on Linux through Wine/Proton; the 1.0 server needs GE-Proton 11. Slot cap is 16.
rows.rea_notes: No managed or IL2CPP metadata, so REA is limited to Ghidra pseudocode, strings and xrefs on the native client and dedicated-server executables. The voxel and world-streaming code would need slow manual recovery.
rows.legal_route: Learn it by playing and by running your own dedicated server (enshrouded_server.json settings, save behaviour) to observe the systems. Do not redistribute or extract assets from the data archive, and do not tamper with online or multiplayer services.
rows.signature_system: All terrain and structures are player-modifiable voxels, so you can dig and build anywhere in up to 16-player co-op. Water and diving were added during Early Access (present by Update 7, Nov 2025), not at 1.0.

rows.name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
rows.developer: Merge Games (the Camlann Games co-credit comes from one database and was not checked)
rows.engine: Unreal Engine, confirmed by the dedicated server layout: it ships SMALLAND/Binaries/Linux/SMALLANDServer-Linux-Shipping and loads /Game/Maps/WorldGame/WorldGame_Smalland. UE4 as the version comes only from third-party databases.
rows.status: Full release 15 Feb 2024 on PC/PS5/Xbox Series (per the cited Gematsu article; not re-checked). PC Early Access began 29 Mar, which I recall as 2022, not the 2023 in the input; the year is unconfirmed.
rows.official_mod_support: None found. No Steam Workshop and no official toolkit; the only official customization is the built-in server modifiers (peaceful mode, friendly fire and so on).
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 808040 with anonymous login (Pterodactyl egg), with a native Linux server binary. A Windows build is reported by hosting guides (not re-checked).
rows.rea_notes: REA would only detect the Unreal layout (Content/Paks); it cannot parse paks or uassets. Any code insight means Ghidra on a large Unreal executable, where engine code buries the gameplay code. The Linux server binary is another, equally native target.
rows.legal_route: Study it by playing and by running the free dedicated server to see how the server modifiers behave. Do not extract or reuse Unreal pak assets, and do not tamper with multiplayer services.
rows.signature_system: Miniature-scale open-world survival in an oversized wilderness, with up to 10-player co-op, creature taming and riding, and tunable server modifiers.

rows.name: The Infected
rows.developer: DigX Studios (originally one developer); not re-checked
rows.engine: Probably Unreal Engine 4. The evidence is a config path ending Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor, which is Unreal's layout, and one player's UE4 crash report. There is no official statement, and none of this was re-checked in this run.
rows.status: Early Access on Steam since 7 Aug 2020 and still updating (V22 in 2025, V23 beta in 2026); no 1.0 found. Not re-checked this run.
rows.official_mod_support: none (Steam forum users report no known mods)
rows.free_dedicated_server: unknown (listings disagree on co-op; one lists the mode as solo)
rows.rea_notes: If it is Unreal, REA would only detect the engine. Gameplay logic (base power and water networks, farming) would need Ghidra on the large executable, which is slow and low-yield. The engine is unconfirmed, so run inspect_desktop_application on a local install first. If it is not Unreal, reclassify.
rows.legal_route: Study it by playing and documenting the base power/water, farming and husbandry rules from observation. Do not extract assets and do not use the unstable third-party trainers.
rows.signature_system: Deep base building with connected power and water systems, plus farming, hunting and animal husbandry, and optional 'Vambie' hordes that can be turned off.

rows.name: UnReal World
rows.developer: Sami Maaranen and Erkka Lehmus (Enormous Elk)
rows.engine: Custom 2D tile engine, rewritten in C in the mid-1990s (per Wikipedia; not re-checked). SDL use not confirmed.
rows.status: First released 1992 and still updated; on Steam since Feb 2016. The recent version numbers (3.86 in Apr 2025, then 3.87) were not re-checked.
rows.official_mod_support: Data-file modding only: plain-text definitions (e.g. flora_*.txt), documented changeable weapon and clothing properties, and sprite replacement. The official wiki keeps a Mods page. No code API.
rows.free_dedicated_server: no (single-player roguelike)
rows.rea_notes: Native C binaries, so REA gives Ghidra pseudocode, strings and xrefs. The small, older codebase is more tractable than a modern engine, and the text data files are readable without tools.
rows.legal_route: Learn the rules from play and from the plain-text data files and documented mod properties, which show item and plant parameters. Do not copy the code, tiles or other assets.
rows.signature_system: Open-ended, very granular Iron Age wilderness survival (hunting, trapping, crafting, seasons) on a 2D tile world, with data-defined flora and item properties.

rows.name: Eco (Strange Loop Games)
rows.engine: Unity client: the official ModKit client project was pinned to Unity 2020.3.4f1 as of Dec 2022; the scripting backend is not verified. Plus a standalone .NET C# dedicated server: the ModKit server examples target net5.0, and the server runs natively on Linux as ./EcoServer.
rows.status: Early Access since 6 Feb 2018. 1.0 not confirmed as of Oct 2026; the input's claim that it slipped past a 2024-2025 target was not re-checked.
rows.open_source: no. Server source has reportedly been sold as a source-access tier (2021 tweet; not re-checked). Core gameplay ships as editable C# in Mods/__core__, compiled at server startup, and the official examples confirm overrides in Mods/UserCode.
rows.official_mod_support: Yes: the free ModKit with official examples on GitHub (StrangeLoopGames/EcoModKit): server C# plugins, chat commands, UserCode recipe overrides, a REST API extension, Unity-built client objects and blocksets, and Ecopedia pages. API docs are at docs.play.eco.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 739590 with anonymous login (Pterodactyl egg; LinuxGSM ecoserver). Runs on Windows and natively on Linux.
rows.rea_notes: The server's .NET assemblies (EcoServer.dll, Eco.Gameplay.dll, Eco.Core.dll and so on) suit inspect_managed_artifact and ILSpy, and most gameplay is already readable C# in __core__. The client is Unity with an unverified backend: Mono would give Assembly-CSharp, IL2CPP only metadata names.
rows.legal_route: Use the official ModKit, docs.play.eco and the shipped __core__ C# on a self-hosted server to learn the simulation, or buy official source access if offered. Do not redistribute Strange Loop code or assets, and do not touch play.eco auth or online services.
rows.signature_system: Ecosystem simulation in which player resource use and pollution feed back on species and the world, run on a server that players can fully script in C#, with player-made laws and economy.

rows.name: Stationeers
rows.engine: Unity with the Mono scripting backend, confirmed: the current mod loader builds against rocketstation_Data/Managed/Assembly-CSharp as of Oct 2026. The exact Unity version, including the input's 'Unity 2021' claim, was not verified.
rows.status: Early Access since Dec 2017; 1.0 status not confirmed (the input said there was still no 1.0 in 2026).
rows.official_mod_support: Steam Workshop mods managed from the game (XML data mods such as recipes and presets; the details and the ExampleMod.zip were not re-checked). Code mods use community BepInEx 5.4 plus StationeersLaunchPad (v1.1.0, Oct 2026), which also loads Workshop-distributed mods.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 600760 with anonymous login (Pterodactyl egg; LinuxGSM stserver). Windows rocketstation_DedicatedServer.exe and native Linux rocketstation_DedicatedServer.x86_64.
rows.rea_notes: Mono build confirmed. BepInEx 5.4, which supports Mono only, loads through Doorstop into both the client and the dedicated server, and mods reference Assembly-CSharp from rocketstation_Data/Managed. ILSpy via inspect_managed_artifact should give near-source C# of the atmospherics and IC10 code, and the dedicated server shares the same managed code.
rows.legal_route: Inspect the managed assemblies and XML data locally for study, run the free dedicated server, and use Workshop data mods. Do not copy the decompiled code or assets into a clone, and keep any recreation clean-room.
rows.signature_system: Per-cell atmospherics simulation (temperature, pressure, gas mixtures, combustion) automated with IC10 chips programmed in a MIPS-like assembly.

rows.name: Space Engineers
rows.engine: VRAGE 2.0, Keen's own C# engine on .NET Framework (v4.6.1 in the source snapshot), with SharpDX/DirectX 11 rendering and a native Havok physics wrapper. Not XNA; the runtime enum is the closest managed-.NET bucket.
rows.status: Released and still updated. The GitHub source snapshot's last commit is 6 Jan 2022, and its README marks it 'ARCHIVED VERSION ... not up-to-date'.
rows.open_source: Source-available, not open source: an outdated C# snapshot of the game and VRage (about 3,900 .cs files) on GitHub under Keen's EULA, with no assets. The README marks it archived.
rows.official_mod_support: Yes: the C# ModAPI for mod scripts, in-game Programmable Block C# scripts, SBC definition files and Steam Workshop. Torch (third-party) adds server plugins.
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 298740 with anonymous login (Pterodactyl egg). Windows-only DedicatedServer64/SpaceEngineersDedicated.exe; runs on Linux through Wine.
rows.rea_notes: Technically the best case: the shipped game is .NET, so inspect_managed_artifact and ILSpy would give near-source C#. However, Keen's EULA (s2.2.4, in the source repo) forbids decompiling or reverse engineering except for interoperability. The sanctioned route is reading the archived official source snapshot plus the ModAPI, not decompiling current binaries. Havok is a native DLL (Ghidra only).
rows.legal_route: Use the official ModAPI, the Programmable Block API, the free dedicated server, and the archived source snapshot under its EULA. The EULA allows public GitHub forks and modifications only for Space Engineers mods usable by owners of the game. It forbids standalone apps, using the code in other projects, removing Steam integration, and commercial use without agreement. Do not copy Keen code or assets into a clone; recreate clean-room.
rows.signature_system: Block-built ships and stations with structural destruction and physics, scriptable in-game in C# through Programmable Blocks.

rows.name: Empyrion - Galactic Survival
rows.engine: Unity. The dedicated server is launched with Unity player flags (-batchmode -nographics -logFile), and the Eleon site and Wikipedia also say Unity.
rows.status: Released after leaving Early Access in 2020 (the exact date, 5 Aug 2020, was not re-checked) and still updated. v1.13 in 2025 and the Funcom partnership come from cited sources and were not re-checked.
rows.official_mod_support: Yes: an official Mod API (ModApi.dll and Mif.dll; mods are .NET DLLs), used by active community mods such as EmpyrionScripting (updated Aug 2026). Also scenarios and YAML server configuration.
rows.anti_cheat: EAC (Easy Anti-Cheat). Dedicated servers switch it with ServerConfig.EACActive in dedicated.yaml (default true in the Pterodactyl egg).
rows.free_dedicated_server: yes, SteamCMD app 530870 with anonymous login (Pterodactyl egg). Windows-only DedicatedServer/EmpyrionDedicated.exe; runs on Linux through Wine.
rows.rea_notes: Mono is confirmed indirectly: the EmpyrionScripting mod compiles C# at runtime with Roslyn and checks for Mono.Runtime, which only works on a Mono build, and ModApi.dll and Mif.dll are managed. ILSpy should recover near-source C# of the playfield and structure logic. Analyze offline files only and never touch the EAC module.
rows.legal_route: Use the official Mod API and your own dedicated server with EACActive false, studying local files only. Never bypass or analyze EAC, never join EAC servers with modified clients, and do not copy code or assets.
rows.signature_system: Seamless planet-to-orbit survival with voxel-built ships and bases, simulated across separate per-playfield server processes.

rows.name: Going Medieval
rows.developer: Foxy Voxel. The Irregular Corporation published it during Early Access; the input's 'Mythwright' was not verified.
rows.engine: Unity, confirmed: a community mod launcher builds against 'Going Medieval_Data/Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll' and UnityEngine.CoreModule.dll. The fan-wiki 'custom engine' claim is wrong.
rows.status: Released 1.0 in March 2026 after Early Access from 1 Jun 2021. The Foxy Voxel announcement and the press release give 12 Mar; the input's 17 Mar is unconfirmed.
rows.official_mod_support: Yes: Update 13 'Basic Modding' added Steam Workshop, JSON data mods (resources, equipment, buildings), localization and scenario mods. Custom 3D assets and mod.io for GOG/EGS were planned for later phases.
rows.free_dedicated_server: no (single-player colony sim)
rows.rea_notes: Mono is verified for the Early Access build 0.5.28.6 (2021): the launcher uses Unity-Doorstop and Harmony and references Assembly-CSharp in the Managed folder. Assembly-CSharp should decompile to near-source C#. Not re-checked for 1.0: if 1.0 ships GameAssembly.dll plus global-metadata.dat, only IL2CPP metadata names are available.
rows.legal_route: Use the official JSON and Workshop modding and inspect local game files for study, after accepting the modding EULA. Do not reuse decompiled code or voxel/art assets in a clone.
rows.signature_system: A fully 3D voxel colony sim where settlers dig cellars and build multi-level fortifications, driven by priority-based settler autonomy.

rows.name: Stranded: Alien Dawn
rows.engine: HaemimontSol Engine (in-house C++), gameplay scripted in Lua
rows.official_mod_support: Yes: official Mod Editor with Steam Workshop upload and sample mods. A later patch added a Lua Debug Adapter for VS Code and now installs the game's Lua source for reference.
rows.rea_notes: REA has no profile for HaemimontSol or its HPK archives, so engine internals would need Ghidra on the native exe. Gameplay logic already ships as readable Lua source, so REA adds little.
rows.legal_route: Study through the official Mod Editor, the Lua source shipped for reference, and the sample mods. Do not repackage Haemimont's Lua or assets in a clean-room project.
rows.signature_system: Autonomous survivors with skills, traits, happiness/mental health and injuries that can be permanent, kept alive against alien wildlife (including flying threats) and extreme weather.
rows.status: released (1.0 on 25 April 2023, after early access)
rows.free_dedicated_server: unknown (no multiplayer mentioned in any source seen)

rows.name: Caves of Qud
rows.engine: Unity (Mono; game code in Assembly-CSharp.dll, C# 9)
rows.open_source: no (wiki states there is no public source repository)
rows.official_mod_support: Yes: in-game mod manager, XML blueprint modding (ObjectBlueprints.xml parts), C# script mods compiled by the game, Harmony bundled, and a Steam Workshop uploader.
rows.rea_notes: inspect_managed_artifact plus ILSpy on Assembly-CSharp.dll would give near-source C# for the parts/event system; the official wiki itself points modders to ILSpy. The game compiling C# mods at runtime and bundling Harmony is consistent with a Mono (JIT) build, not IL2CPP. Use this to understand the code, not to copy it.
rows.legal_route: Use the official XML/C# modding docs, the open-source example mods and a local decompile to learn the system design. Rebuild clean-room and do not copy decompiled code or assets.
rows.signature_system: Component ('parts') and event object model driving deep physical/social simulation, plus procedurally generated sultan histories built by generating events first and rationalising them afterwards.
rows.status: released (1.0 on 5 December 2024)
rows.free_dedicated_server: no (single-player)

rows.name: NEO Scavenger
rows.engine: Adobe Flash, built with the Flixel library and FlashDevelop
rows.open_source: no (built with open-source tools, but no source found for the game itself)
rows.official_mod_support: Data-driven: since 2014 the game loads its data from external XML files and images from a folder. The developer has a pinned modding-documentation thread and a modding forum; no Workshop or mod manager.
rows.rea_notes: REA has no SWF/ActionScript decompiler, so its managed and native tools do not apply to the Flash code. The most useful material is the plain-text XML data tables, which can be read without REA.
rows.legal_route: Learn from the official XML data and modding documentation, and by playtesting. Do not decompile and reuse the SWF code or redistribute art.
rows.signature_system: Detailed body-condition simulation (wounds that become infected, hypothermia, fatigue, thirst, disease), set on a hex map where line of sight, elevation and tracks matter.
rows.status: released (PC December 2014; iOS/Android 2017)
rows.free_dedicated_server: no (single-player)

rows.name: Project Castaway
rows.engine: Unity (SteamDB-detected technologies include Unity IL2CPP, Burst and DLSS)
